name: tickflare
description: Multiplayer game framework for Cloudflare Workers and Durable Objects

scripts.dev: npm run build:example && wrangler dev --config examples/tic-tac-toe/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.dev:arena: npm run build:example && wrangler dev --config examples/arena/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.dev:skirmish: npm run build:example && wrangler dev --config examples/skirmish/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.dev:ranked: npm run build:example && wrangler dev --config examples/ranked/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.build:example: esbuild src/client/index.ts --bundle --format=esm --outfile=examples/tic-tac-toe/public/tickflare-client.js && esbuild src/client/index.ts --bundle --format=esm --outfile=examples/arena/public/tickflare-client.js && esbuild src/client/index.ts --bundle --format=esm --outfile=examples/skirmish/public/tickflare-client.js && esbuild src/client/index.ts --bundle --format=esm --outfile=examples/ranked/public/tickflare-client.js
scripts.docs:dev: npm --prefix docs install && npm --prefix docs run dev
scripts.docs:build: npm --prefix docs ci && npm --prefix docs run build
